    As a reputable manufacturer of Black Nitrile Powder Free Examination Gloves, we supply premium-grade disposable gloves designed for hospitals, clinics, tattoo studios, salons, and industrial applications. These gloves provide a combination of strength, hygiene, and user comfort, thanks to our advanced nitrile manufacturing process. Our gloves are non-sterile, latex-free, powder-free, and suitable for long-duration use without causing irritation or sweating.

    Each glove is crafted with a micro-textured surface that enhances grip during medical examinations, tattoo work, hair coloring, chemical application, and industrial handling. The gloves' 240mm length offers extra protection against spills, grease, ink, and chemicals commonly used in professional environments. They are resistant to punctures, tears, and stretching, ensuring dependable performance during heavy tasks.

    We supply bulk quantities for distributors, wholesalers, corporate buyers, and IndiaMART customers across India. Our manufacturing plant ensures continuous production and strict quality control, delivering consistent glove thickness, elasticity, and finishing. Whether you are a reseller or direct user, our nitrile gloves offer excellent value and durability.
